entities.name: B8EI29 ubiquinone O-methyltransferase
observations: Exact sequence match (100% identity and coverage) to reviewed UniProt B8EI29 from Methylocella silvestris; annotated as an O-methyltransferase in ubiquinone biosynthesis.
Annotated EC 2.1.1.222 and EC 2.1.1.64, catalyzing two ubiquinone-pathway O-methylations using S-adenosyl-L-methionine.

entities.name: Ubiquinol ring O-methylation
observations: 3-demethylubiquinol + S-adenosyl-L-methionine → ubiquinol + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H+; Rhea RHEA:44380.
